name: Golf ball
headline: diameter
description: A golf ball is a small dimpled ball, and the Rules of Golf, written jointly by The R&A and the USGA, limit how small and how heavy it can be. It must be at least 1.680 in (42.67 mm) across and weigh no more than 1.620 oz (45.93 g). The rules set only these two limits on size and weight: a minimum diameter and a maximum weight.

measures.label: Diameter
measures.note: Minimum diameter allowed by the Rules of Equipment, 1.680 in (42.67 mm)

measures.label: Weight
measures.note: Maximum weight allowed, 1.620 ounces avoirdupois (45.93 g)

facts.text: The rules set only a minimum diameter and a maximum weight, so a legal golf ball can be larger or lighter than these limits.

sources.title: The Rules of Equipment, Part 4: Conformance of Balls

caveats: The diameter is the rule's minimum; the typical diameter of balls on sale was not found in a primary source.
